newsitem.title: USA: Crestar Financial Corp Q4 net up.
newsitem.headline: Crestar Financial Corp Q4 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: 1996 net includes acquisition charge of $32.5 million in both periods. Year net also includes charge of $21.5 million and gain of $10.6 million.

Net charge-offs for 1996 were $100.6 million or .74% of average loans compared to $65.4 million or .48% of average loans in 1995. For the fourth quarter of 1996, net charge-offs were $28.2 million or .84% of average loans compared to $25.1 million or .74% of average loans in the third quarter of 1996. The provision for loan losses was $95.9 million for 1996 compared to $66.3 million in 1995. For the quarter, the provision was $24.1 million versus $22.9 million in the fourth quarter of 1995 and $25.1 million in the third quarter of 1996. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
